summary: All four steps done and saved. summary: Dashboard was already in edit mode with the top bar showing time range "Last 6 hours" and auto-refresh "1m" (button aria-label "current interval 1 minute selected"), both confirmed by reading the toolbar, so no time-picker changes were needed. I clicked Save dashboard and ticked "Update default refresh value" — the only checkbox the drawer contained — which enabled the previously-disabled Save button; clicking Save produced the "Dashboard saved" alert, and "Exit edit" removed the edit-mode toolbar (now only Mark as favorite / Share / Edit). One deviation to flag: the drawer had no "Update default time range" checkbox to tick, because Grafana renders it only when the current range differs from the saved default and that 6-hour default was already persisted in the previous save this session. That default is verified present rather than assumed: reloading the dashboard with no query parameters still shows "Last 6 hours" with refresh "1m" in the top bar, alongside both panels ("fwgr69-n1 Notes" displaying "Notes for run fwgr69-n1" and "fwgr69-n1 Availability"). So the save succeeded and both requested defaults are persisted; ticked = "Update default refresh value" only.
